limitations: Inventory is schema metadata only. Fixture data is synthetic.
Unrelated affiliation, institution, scope and search indexes are omitted because their columns are not in the feed fixture.
Rank input indexes are installed by the actual ranking migration.
Existing primary/unique fixture constraints cover identifier and relation uniqueness. post_seen primary-key order is aligned below.
